title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: The creative-generation MCP layer is consolidating — Higgsfield, Scenario, and Imagine each expose dozens-to-hundreds of image/video/3D/audio models behind one agent-callable connector
bullets.summary: Higgsfield MCP ships agentic access to 30+ image/video models (Seedance 2.0, Sora 2, Veo, Kling, Nano Banana Pro) through one connector URL; Scenario MCP exposes 79 tools and 550+ models for image/video/3D/audio; Imagine MCP chains generate to upscale to background-removal to video in one agent session. Same shift Omneky signaled Jul 10, now a clear category.
bullets.how: The creative primitive for Brand 9 Signs and PRAGMA's operator wedge — and we already have a Higgsfield-class MCP connected. Standardize on ONE creative-ops MCP behind graphic-designer/Pulse, test output against our signage + brand voice, and stack with ad-platform MCPs into a make-and-launch loop, rather than juggling three overlapping creative connectors.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'From Prompts to Contracts — Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents' reframes production agents as code, manifests, schemas, and validation artifacts, not clever prompts
bullets.summary: Submitted Jul 9: enterprise agents start as prompt-carried prototypes but productizing them demands source boundaries, entity routing, answer contracts, and reproducible traces; the paper moves deterministic behavior out of the prompt and into code/manifests/schemas/validation so every answer is traceable and auditable.
bullets.how: PRAGMA's durable moat stated plainly: the sellable deliverable for AI-operator clients is an AUDITABLE agent (deterministic logic in code + reproducible traces), not a prompt-clever demo. It also disciplines The Construct's own fleet — push each agent's non-negotiable behavior into manifests/schemas and keep the prompt for judgment only.

bullets.title: AgentPrizm launches AgentMemory + AgentSkills — persistent cross-session memory and reusable skills via a REST API paired with MCP infrastructure
bullets.summary: Launched Jul 9 for developers and enterprise teams: durable agent memory that survives across sessions plus a packaged, reusable skills layer.
bullets.how: The Construct already runs a two-tier memory system (CLAUDE.md + ~/.hermes/memories/) and a skills fleet, so this is a benchmark, not a buy. Worth checking whether a managed memory/skills backend beats our file-based approach for cross-agent recall, but our stack is bespoke and switching cost is high. Watch, don't adopt.

bullets.title: Featured launches an MCP server for PR agencies — agents find media queries, journalists, podcasts, byline outlets, influencers, speaking calls, and awards from one natural-language request
bullets.summary: Announced Jul 7: the earned-media discovery surface is now agent-callable from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client.
bullets.how: A natural extension of Pulse's owned-presence remit into earned media: a Construct agent could source podcast/speaking/byline opportunities for Bobby (Robert Louis Hartley) and Brand 9 Signs on a schedule. Low-cost to test behind Pulse; validate the media database actually covers signage/local-B2B before leaning on it.

praxis_lesson: Two threads converge today. First, agent-callable creative generation has gone from a single vendor to a category (Higgsfield/Scenario/Imagine/Omneky) — so Brand 9 Signs should pick one creative-ops MCP and standardize the make-and-launch loop behind graphic-designer/Pulse instead of collecting connectors. Second, the 'Prompts to Contracts' paper names PRAGMA's real moat: the enterprise deliverable is an auditable agent — deterministic behavior in code/manifests/schemas with reproducible traces — not a prompt demo, and that discipline should govern The Construct's own fleet too. Keep memory/skills platforms (AgentPrizm) and earned-media MCPs (Featured) as benchmarks to test cheaply behind existing agents, never as forced re-tooling.
